notes.title: New Setting: Full-screen/Window mode now available!
notes.notes:
Our Hero! First and Our Hero! Two both always forced full-screen at start, but many people asked for the possibility to play the game not in full-screen, so I finally came up with a solution and introduced this easy configuration.
At the start of the game a simple box will let you choose if start playing the game [b]full-screen or in window mode.[/b]
It's a very basic solution for now, but better than nothing 🙂
This setting is available from:
[b]- Version 1.2.0 in Our Hero! First
- Version 1.1.0 in Our Hero! Two[/b]
[b]One more tip: you can always [/b] press [u]ALT + ENTER[/u] any time to toggle full-screen mode 😉
This setting has been fine-tuned during the development of the third and last chapter of the saga, Our Hero! Last, so it will be available at game launch there.
If you didn't already do so, add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076920/Our_Hero_Last/]Our Hero! Last[/url] to your wish list!
Follow [url=https://twitter.com/stesproject]stesproject on Twitter[/url] to stay up to date with the development!
The release of the last chapter is planned for October 2022 🙂

Thank you for playing.
See you soon! ❣️

notes.title: Our Hero! First: free for everyone from February 2nd!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Announcing Our Hero! Two!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce the next chapter of the Our Hero! saga: [b]Our Hero! Two[/b]!
Our Hero! Two demo is out now and will join the Steam Game Festival Autumn 2020 (starting October 7th)!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408050/Our_Hero_Two/ style=button]Discover more on Our Hero! Two[/url]

[b]The Story[/b]
Our Beloved King Has died.
A hitherto unknown party has laid his claim to the throne, but his intentions are all but benign.
He plans to siphon the special powers of every weapon in the world and collect them all into a single sword: his own!
If nobody can stop him, his plan could plunge the heroes’ world into ruin, and he seems to even have ulterior motives than those…
Fortunately, before the King perished he managed to gather two more heroes, who will be accompanying and assisting Ourhero in his quest!
Prepare yourself, for the world of heroes needs you!

notes.title: Our Hero! First now localized in Spanish and French!
notes.notes:
Our heroes learnt to speak Spanish and French both!
Dear Spanish and French players (and not only), you can now enjoy the game fully translated in these languages.
Hope you can enjoy the game even more :3

If you find any localization issue for your language, please refer to the discussion "Localization issues" in the forum "Feedback & Suggestions".
Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0: multi language support is here!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.0 of Our Hero! First has been released!
This new version introduces some minor bug fixes, many improvements and most important the multi language support!

We have the game available in 2 languages now: English and Italian.
More languages will be added over time, Spanish in the first place!

You can select and change your preferred language from the main menu.
Everything is translated: all game dialogues, weapons, skills, items and location names!

We hope you'll enjoy this new version of Our Hero! First!
See you soon :)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is here + we started working on Multi Language support
notes.notes:
Today is releasing patch 1.0.2 for Our Hero! First! This patch introduces little general improvements and minor bug fixes for an even smoother and better in-game experience!

However the biggest news is about multi language support: the support for more languages other than English is under development!
The first language that will be introduced will be Italian, followed by Spanish thanks to a collaboration with Nicolas Eyaralar (thank you!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664625/cdb205bb5439684856621c524b4b613fa744911a.gif[/img]

Stay tuned and if you are interested to have the game translated in your language, just send me a message. We can probably find a deal and collaborate together to make it! :)

notes.title: Our Hero! First: out now!
notes.notes:
Someone may have known Our Hero! Hyper Sword, a different project developed with different tools and too great ambitions.
It had great ambitions, since I realized it was basically not possible for me alone, with a full time job, finishing such huge game.
That's why [b]Our Hero! First[/b] comes.
This game comes from the strong desire to finally release one of my most loved adventure, worldwide.
Because, eventually, you realize that what matters is doing.
Do something, complete it, then leave your trace in the world.
It will have some sort of meaning, in any case.
I'm so happy today to share this game with you, guys, and to finally have one of my games selling on Steam!
It's a small step, but still something!
I hope you'll enjoy my story and that it'll be just the [i]First[/i] of a long series of cool games!

Now go play the game!
See you! :)

notes.title: A game dedicated to my uncle
notes.notes:
I was going to post a very standard update about the release of this game, but then something happened.
I will talk about my uncle.

My uncle really loved video games. He played a lot of them.
He is the person who made me know and love this world.
Everything started with Sonic the Hedgehog for the Mega Drive, when I was really young.
Then came the PS1, with Spyro. 
Oh, how much I loved these games.
I still love them.
Unexpectedly my love for video games eventually became love for what is hidden behind a game, how they are made and for what purpose.
Later on I started developing games.
The funny thing is that eventually I teached to my uncle how to develop games! I still remember his attempts making a game with RPG Maker. He always had a really vivid imagination...
My uncle died, yesterday, 17th of July 2020.
I owe him a lot. I hope I have even just a little bit of his great imagination.
Thank you, zio Michele.
I will continue creating games in your memory.
Goodbye.
